findings.value: Daily entry is paid: adult £14.50 to £15.50 and concession £10 to £11, both including a donation. Punchcards, 30-day passes and monthly memberships are also sold. The centre says climbing prices stayed the same for 2026.

evidence.quote: Anyone can continue to climb at Mile End for the same cost for the next year

findings.value: Under-14s cannot climb or boulder unsupervised; 14 to 17s can boulder independently after a competency test

evidence.quote: Juniors under 14 can’t be signed off to climb or boulder unsupervised.
Juniors between ages of 14 and 17 can boulder independently if they have relevant experience and can pass competency test

notes: Unprofiled. The site has no access page (checked: /accessibility and /access are 404; the contact, first-visit, about and sauna pages say nothing about step-free access or toilets). Nearest tube Mile End per the contact page. Prices are from the first-visit page, which is the only price list. The sauna is bookable (mixed gender, 14 max or 9 off-peak). Socials include a monthly Queer Climb and a Women's social session, per the socials page; not used here. Registry id and address match the page.
